thesis: Unchanged from 8 September and a little more confident in it. NVDA is -5.3%, the worst position in the book, momentum has decayed from +12.3% on 6 September to +6.7%, and the stock fell another 2% on Thursday. The company is fine; the trade is not working, and a confirmed hike next week is not the environment in which the highest-multiple megacap re-rates upward.
bull_case: Nothing in the business has deteriorated. The 26 August quarter delivered revenue of $96.22B against $92.17B consensus, data centre $89.0B up 117% year on year, and a Q3 guide of $108B that assumes no China data centre compute at all. Management points to roughly 70% revenue growth continuing into fiscal 2028. NVIDIA trades around 23x its current-year outlook, which is not a bubble multiple for that growth rate, and it remains the largest holding in XLK at about 16%. The packet still shows close > SMA50 > SMA200 with RSI 53, and our trailing stop at 211.31 has not been threatened - price is 218.29.
bear_case: Five sessions of decay with no bounce. Score has gone +0.67 (6 Sep) to +0.43 (8 Sep) to +0.42 today, momentum +12.3% to +6.7%, and the position is -5.3%. Semiconductors were muted on Friday even as the Dow and Nasdaq rose 0.9% - rising yields and a lead researcher at Anthropic warning publicly about AI dangers kept the group offered, which is a reminder that this sector now carries headline risk from the AI debate itself, not just from demand. The vendor-financing concern stands: a reported $500B AI financing arrangement cost $130B of market value on 10 August. August CPI landed this morning and settled the argument: headline +0.4% m/m and 3.4% year on year, core +0.3% m/m against a 0.2% estimate, with gasoline up 3.9% and accounting for over a third of the monthly increase. Hike odds for 15-16 Sep jumped on the print - sources put them anywhere from ~69% to 85-90%, but every one of them agrees the direction is a hike being priced. The fed funds rate has sat at 3.5-3.75% all year. A stock that cannot rally on a 0.9% Nasdaq day is not being accumulated.
catalysts: 15-16 Sep 2026 FOMC decision and dot plot
Hyperscaler capex commentary through the autumn conference season
Q3 FY2027 results in late Nov 2026 against the $108B guide
risks: Five sessions of score and momentum decay with no bounce
Semis muted on an up day for the indices
AI-safety headline risk now moving the sector independently of demand
Vendor-financed demand: $500B arrangement, $130B of value lost on 10 Aug
Hike priced after a 3.4% CPI print, on the highest-multiple megacap
invalidation: Unchanged from 8 Sep: flips back to long on a daily close above 236 held two sessions, restoring the 55-day high. The bear case confirms on two consecutive closes below 210 or any top-four hyperscaler guiding 2027 AI capex lower; the trailing stop is 211.31.
